title: Test Drive Orchard Core: Run It From Source | Orchard Core
description:
Before you build an application with Orchard Core, you can see what it does. There are several ways to try it, from a hosted demo to the full source code, and the choice is not obvious.

This video compares the ways to test drive Orchard Core, then runs the source code on your machine: you clone the repository, start the OrchardCore.Cms.Web project, go through the Setup screen, and sign in to the admin.

In this video:
• Four ways to test drive: Try Orchard Core, DotNest, Docker and the source code
• Run it from source: install the .NET SDK, clone the repository and start the site
• Set up the site with the Setup screen
• Look around the home page and the admin
• What you ran: Program.cs, Auto Setup and the layout of the repository
• Where the site keeps its data, and how to start over
